key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:193A
name: fill_records_from_stream_pairs
description: Reads two parallel byte streams and a lookup table, and for each step writes zero-filled four-byte records into an output buffer, adding a fill byte and word when a flag bit is clear. It returns when the source stream reaches the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1946
name: emit_record_runs_from_stream
description: Walks two byte streams against a flag table and writes runs of zero-filled records, with optional fill values, into an output buffer until the end marker of 255 is read. It returns zero when the stream ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1966
name: emit_packed_count_record_runs
description: Decodes packed run counts from a data stream and writes blocks of zero-filled records with an optional fill word into an output buffer. It exits through a shared loop once a count is exhausted and returns to the caller.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1970
name: compact_parallel_table_entries
description: Copies three parallel byte tables in place, keeping only entries whose flag bit in the lookup table is clear. It writes the end marker of 255 after the last kept entry in each table and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19B0
name: write_byte_to_three_pointers
description: Stores one byte from a data register into three memory locations, each addressed by its own address register, and returns. It has no loop or branch.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19BC
name: call_two_handlers_in_sequence
description: Calls two unnamed handler routines one after the other and returns. It handles no data itself and only sequences the two calls.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19C4
name: clear_low_nibbles_mark_flags
description: Clears the low four bits of each entry in one table up to its end marker, then walks two linked tables and sets flag bits on the entries that begin and end each run. It uses a per-byte attribute table to choose which entries are marked.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19D8
name: set_table_flag_bits_walk
description: Walks two linked byte tables and sets flag bits on the entries that begin and end each run, using a per-byte attribute table to choose them. It returns when the table reaches its end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19F2
name: mark_run_flags_from_stream
description: Reads a byte stream and walks a flag table in step with it, setting flag bits on the boundary entry of each run until the stream reaches its end marker. Several attribute tests decide which entry in a run is marked.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A24
name: mark_run_boundary_flags_nested
description: Walks two linked tables with nested loops and sets flag bits on the first and last entry of each run, choosing the marked entry with attribute tests. It returns when the end marker of 255 is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A48
name: mark_run_end_flags
description: Walks a flag table against an attribute table and sets flag bit values on run starts and ends. A matching attribute bit redirects the mark to the following entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A72
name: set_flag_bits_walking_tables
description: Walks paired byte tables and sets the first two flag bits on each entry where a run begins, then sets a third bit on the run's closing entry. It repeats until the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A78
name: mark_run_edge_flags
description: Sets flag bits on the opening and closing entries of each run in a flag table, using a lookup table to decide which neighbour gets the mark. The loop stops at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A8E
name: compute_divided_period_records
description: Divides a fixed constant by stored period values to produce output values, then fills eight-byte records from several parallel tables. A separate branch writes one divided value across a table of records when the mode value is one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1AF0
name: write_period_bytes_by_block
description: Divides a fixed constant by stored parameter values and writes the quotients into eight-byte record fields, looping over blocks that end at the end marker of 255. The final value written uses a separate table entry as the divisor.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B00
name: emit_divided_period_block_records
description: Writes divided period values into grouped eight-byte records, with each group's length taken from a length table. It stops at the end marker of 255 and writes one last quotient using a table entry as divisor.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B34
name: fill_divided_values_across_runs
description: Computes quotients from a fixed constant and per-entry parameter bytes, and spreads them over runs of records bounded by flag bits. The routine ends when the stream reaches the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B48
name: fill_values_with_run_lengths
description: Writes divided parameter values into record fields across runs whose lengths come from a flag-marked table. It repeats until the end marker of 255 and then writes a final value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BB4
name: write_values_per_block_pair
description: Loops over blocks of records, writing quotients of a fixed constant and stored parameter bytes into record fields, with a sub-loop that counts run lengths. It returns when the end marker of 255 is read from the block table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BCA
name: fill_quotient_into_strided_fields
description: Divides a fixed constant by a stored value and writes the quotient into every eighth byte of a buffer until a sentinel byte of minus one. The routine returns after that write loop.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE4
name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Returns immediately without reading or writing any data. It is an empty stub, not a real routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE8
name: compute_clamped_level_per_entry
description: Walks entries until the end marker of 255, calling unnamed handler routines selected by flag bits, and merges a scaled lookup value into the low six bits of each output byte. The value is clamped to 63 and the top two bits of the output byte are kept.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C22
name: compute_clamped_level_entries_loop
description: Loops over entries until the end marker of 255, calls unnamed handler routines selected by flag bits, and merges a scaled lookup value into the low six bits of each output byte. The value is clamped to 63 and the top two bits of the output byte are kept.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C3A
name: compute_clamped_levels_from_table
description: Walks entry tables, skipping entries whose flag bit is set, and calls unnamed handlers chosen by neighbouring flag bits before writing a clamped value of at most 63 into each output byte. It returns at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C42
name: compute_clamped_levels_with_fallback
description: Writes a clamped value of at most 63 into the low six bits of each output byte, using 24 as a fallback for entries that fail a flag test. It calls unnamed handlers along the way and stops at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CBA
name: compute_levels_with_flag_skips
description: Walks entry tables until the end marker of 255 and merges a clamped level of at most 63 into the low six bits of each output byte. Flag bits of the current entry decide which unnamed handler routines are called.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CD2
name: compute_levels_neighbour_flags
description: Merges a clamped level of at most 63 into each output byte, choosing the entry from flag bits of neighbouring entries. It calls unnamed handler routines along the way and returns at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CE2
name: compute_clamped_levels_entry_walk
description: Walks entries to the end marker of 255, writing a clamped level of at most 63 into the low six bits of each output byte. Unnamed handler routines are called when flag bits on the current and neighbouring entries match.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CFC
name: compute_clamped_levels_tail_loop
description: Writes clamped levels of at most 63 into the low six bits of output bytes while walking entry tables to the end marker of 255. Its flag tests choose which unnamed handler routines are called first.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D0C
name: compute_clamped_levels_skip_flags
description: Walks entry tables and merges a clamped level of at most 63 into each output byte, skipping entries whose flag bit is set. Neighbouring flag bits select the unnamed handler routines to call before the value is stored.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D8A
name: compute_clamped_levels_pair_flags
description: Writes clamped levels of at most 63 from a table-pair walk, using the flag bits of the current entry and its neighbours to decide the path. It stops at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DA4
name: compute_clamped_levels_run_marks
description: Calls an unnamed handler, then walks entry tables writing clamped levels of at most 63 into output bytes. The walk continues while run-mark flag bits are set and stops at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DAC
name: compute_clamped_levels_run_loop
description: Loops over entry tables and writes clamped levels of at most 63 into output bytes, calling unnamed handler routines when run-mark flag bits match. It returns at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E12
name: multiply_and_round_shift16
description: Multiplies two 16-bit inputs, adds a rounding offset, shifts the product right by five and returns the result. It touches no memory.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E1C
name: clear_tables_set_base_pointers
description: Stores base addresses for eleven working tables in a state block, then zeroes 32-entry blocks of those tables plus two smaller tables. It returns once every table is cleared.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1EE0
name: advance_counter_call_handlers
description: Increments a 16-bit counter in the state block and calls an unnamed handler. When the counter neither wrapped nor overflowed, it calls four more handlers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F02
name: build_entry_flags_and_count
description: Scans a byte table until the end marker of 255, writing packed low nibbles with flag bits into an output table and counting entries. It stops after 128 entries and records the first and last positions of qualifying entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F58
name: pack_flagged_entry_nibbles
description: Packs entries from two byte tables into output bytes by combining low nibbles with flag bits, counting entries up to 128. It records the first and last qualifying positions in the state block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F76
name: pack_entries_with_flag_runs
description: Writes packed output bytes from table entries, tracking flag runs and counting qualifying entries up to 128. It stores the end-of-run flag bit on the last output byte and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FC0
name: mark_last_entry_position
description: Sets the end flag on the last written output byte and records that position and the first qualifying position in the state block. It then returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FD8
name: resolve_output_bytes_backwards
description: Walks output bytes backwards from the entry count, combining flag tables and moving values into earlier slots while clearing vacated ones. It sets marker flags on special codes and returns when the count reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2010
name: pack_entries_then_resolve_flags
description: Packs table entries into output bytes with flag bits until a stop value is read, then walks the packed output backwards to resolve marker flags and shift values into earlier slots.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2032
name: pack_entries_and_resolve_markers
description: Packs entries into output bytes with marker flags and then resolves the marker slots by shifting values into earlier positions. It returns when the packed count is exhausted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2054
name: resolve_packed_marker_slots
description: Walks packed output slots backwards, setting marker bits on special codes and shifting each value into an earlier slot that carries the group flag. It clears vacated slots and returns when the count reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:206C
name: resolve_marker_slots_from_index
description: Walks output slots backwards from a given index, marking entries with flag bits and shifting values into earlier slots. It returns when the index drops below zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:208E
name: shift_marker_values_backwards
description: Walks packed slots backwards, shifting values into earlier slots whose flag bit is clear and setting marker bits on special codes. It returns when the index reaches the start of the table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20A8
name: shift_values_into_marked_slots
description: Copies values into earlier marked slots while walking packed output backwards, clearing vacated positions and setting group flag bits. It returns when the index runs out.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20BC
name: set_low_flag_bit_countdown
description: Sets the lowest flag bit on every entry of a state table, counting down from a given index to zero. It returns once the count is exhausted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20C4
name: set_flag_bit_countdown_inplace
description: Sets flag bit 1 on each byte of an input block, counting down from a given index to zero. It returns when the count reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20D0
name: set_class_flags_until_stop
description: Maps the class byte before the current position to a flag value and ORs it into flag bytes, walking backwards until a stop bit is found. It returns when the walk stops.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:210A
name: apply_class_flags_last_entry
description: Writes a class flag byte at the current position, then, when a counter is nonzero, clears the low nibble of the last flagged entry and sets its bit 4. It returns after updating the state block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2160
name: add_offset_to_seven_counters
description: Optionally calls unnamed handler routines, then adds a stored offset to seven 32-bit counters in the state block. It returns after the seventh addition.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21B8
name: compute_banded_table_value
description: Computes a value from a scaled parameter pair and a fixed offset, clamps it so that results below 126 become 125 and results above 164 become 165, then stores it in a table entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21F2
name: store_clamped_band_value
description: Clamps a value in a register so that results below 126 become 125 and results above 164 become 165, then stores it at an index in the output table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:220C
name: smooth_and_scale_flagged_values
description: Adjusts a table of signed values by subtracting a stepped amount after a start index, applies difference-based corrections to flagged entries walking backwards, then scales each flagged entry by a four-bit factor around a fixed offset.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:22B6
name: apply_neighbour_difference_correction
description: Walks backwards through flagged entries, adding a correction that depends on the difference to the neighbouring entry, and then scales the flagged entries by a four-bit factor. It returns when the walk reaches the start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:230C
name: compute_paired_scaled_outputs
description: For each flagged entry, computes two output values from a four-bit signed nibble and a fixed-offset input, adding a rounded term when a second flag is set. It then stores the final entry relative to the fixed offset.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2394
name: apply_rounded_pair_scaling_backwards
description: Walks flagged entries backwards and updates each pair of output values from a four-bit nibble and a fixed-offset input, adding rounded terms. It stops when the index reaches the start and stores the last entry relative to the fixed offset.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23B2
name: store_scaled_pairs_with_rounding
description: Adds rounded scaled terms to a pair of output tables for each flagged entry, walking backwards until the index reaches the start. It then writes the final entry relative to a fixed offset.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23CE
name: smooth_flagged_value_pairs_backwards
description: Walks flagged entries backwards and adjusts each pair of table values by fixed-point multiply-and-shift steps that depend on the gap between flags. The walk ends at the start of the table and then rescales the flagged entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23E0
name: smooth_value_pairs_by_gap
description: Adjusts pairs of flagged table values with fixed-point steps chosen by the gap size between flags, walking backwards to the start of the table. It finishes by rescaling flagged entries against a running maximum.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:240C
name: rescale_pairs_with_neighbour_correction
description: Applies fixed-point adjustments to value pairs and a neighbour correction to the second value, walking flagged entries backwards. It ends by rescaling flagged entries using a fixed offset chosen by a four-bit class.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:242A
name: rescale_pairs_and_propagate_maximum
description: Adjusts flagged value pairs with fixed-point steps, then scales each flagged entry against the largest earlier value or a fixed offset depending on its class nibble. It returns when the walk reaches the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:244A
name: smooth_pairs_with_gap_scaling
description: Adjusts pairs of table values with fixed-point steps whose size depends on the gap between flagged entries, walking backwards to the start of the table. It then runs the final maximum-based rescaling pass over flagged entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:246A
name: smooth_pairs_then_scale_maximum
description: Applies fixed-point corrections to pairs of table values walking backwards, then scales each flagged entry against the largest earlier value or a fixed offset. It returns when the walk reaches the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:248E
name: propagate_pair_corrections_backwards
description: Propagates a correction value from each flagged pair into the earlier entries while walking backwards, and applies the fixed-point adjustments to both tables. It returns when the walk ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2496
name: scale_pairs_by_gap_class
description: Scales pairs of table values with fixed-point factors chosen by the gap between flags, then rescales flagged entries using a fixed offset for each class nibble. It returns when the table start is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24BE
name: smooth_pairs_stored_gap_factor
description: Applies fixed-point corrections to pairs of table values using a gap factor kept from the previous step, walking backwards through flagged entries. It finishes with a maximum-based rescaling of the flagged entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24DA
name: smooth_pairs_resume_after_gap
description: Resumes the fixed-point pair corrections after a flagged gap, updating both tables and the second entry of each pair. It walks to the table start and then rescales flagged entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2506
name: smooth_pairs_resume_pair_end
description: Continues the backwards pair corrections at the end of a pair, applying fixed-point steps to the second table and the flagged entries. It returns when the walk reaches the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2532
name: smooth_pairs_with_final_maximum
description: Applies fixed-point corrections to pairs of table values walking backwards, then scales each flagged entry against a running maximum or a fixed offset. It returns when the walk reaches the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25AC
name: rescale_entries_to_running_maximum
description: Walks flagged entries backwards and scales each against the largest earlier value in its run, using a fixed offset for class-four entries. It returns when the index reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25C0
name: rescale_entries_with_carried_maximum
description: Scales the current entry by a fixed factor, carries the largest value seen so far into the next scaling step, and writes the reduced value into the second table. It returns at the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25D4
name: rescale_entries_maximum_reference_loop
description: Repeats the maximum-referenced rescaling over flagged entries, updating the reference value as each run is consumed. It returns once the walk reaches the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25F8
name: scale_entries_by_class_nibble
description: Scales each flagged table entry by a factor chosen from its class nibble, with values of one or two taking special factors, and writes the results to a parallel table. It returns at the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2608
name: scale_entries_flag_nibble_back
description: Walks flagged entries backwards and applies a fixed-point scale to each, with the factor selected by the low flag nibble. It returns when the index reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2632
name: scale_entries_flag_nibble_rounded
description: Applies a rounded fixed-point scale to flagged entries walking backwards, with the factor chosen by the flag nibble. It returns at the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2642
name: distribute_corrections_class_reset
description: Spreads run corrections across flagged runs and resets trailing values when a class nibble is set. It calls unnamed handler routines for short runs and returns when the table start is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:26E8
name: distribute_run_corrections_copy_forward
description: Copies table values forward across each flagged run, subtracting a per-run correction from each copy. It fills the closing entry with a maximum-based value or a fixed marker and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:270C
name: distribute_run_corrections_run_loop
description: Loops over flagged runs, copying values forward and subtracting a share of the run correction, then writes the closing entry from a maximum or fixed marker. It returns when the run count is exhausted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:273A
name: spread_corrections_fill_copies
description: Spreads run corrections over flagged entries while copying values forward, with fill values written for the entries between flags. It returns after the closing entry is written.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2762
name: spread_corrections_handler_calls
description: Spreads run corrections across flagged runs and calls unnamed handler routines when a run has one or two entries. It returns after the closing entry is stored.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2770
name: spread_run_corrections_handler_fallback
description: Spreads run corrections over flagged entries, calling unnamed handler routines for runs of one or two and using a copy loop for longer runs. It returns after the closing entry is written.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:277E
name: fill_run_tail_class_base
description: Fills trailing table entries with a base value of 110 plus a class nibble, then spreads the corrections across the last flagged run. It writes the closing entry from a maximum or fixed marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:278A
name: fill_tail_base_then_close
description: Writes trailing entries as 110 plus a nibble offset, spreads run corrections and writes the closing entry from a maximum-based value or fixed marker. It returns once the tail is written.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27C8
name: spread_corrections_for_class_mode
description: Spreads a correction across the last flagged run using a per-class base of 110 or 75. Class eight writes a maximum-based closing entry, and the routine returns when the run is filled.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27F2
name: copy_run_values_close_entry
description: Copies a run of table values forward while subtracting a correction from each copy, then writes the closing entry as a maximum-based value or a fixed marker of 75 or 110.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:282C
name: write_maximum_based_closing_entry
description: Scans the output values for their largest value, scales it by a fixed factor, and writes the result as the closing entry with its paired copies. It returns after storing the entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2834
name: scale_maximum_into_closing_entry
description: Finds the largest value in a run of output bytes, scales it by a fixed factor and writes the result as the closing entry. It returns once that entry is stored.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2864
name: adjust_tables_flag_walk_backwards
description: Walks table entries backwards, applying fixed-point adjustments to three parallel tables where flag bits match, and writes the scaled corrections into a fourth table. It returns at the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:287E
name: adjust_tables_flag_fallback_walk
description: Walks flagged entries backwards with fixed-point adjustments, using fallback scale factors when a flag test does not match. It returns once every entry is processed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28B8
name: adjust_tables_walking_backwards
description: Walks table entries backwards, adjusting parallel tables with fixed-point steps selected by flag bits and writing a scaled correction into a fourth table. It returns when the index reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28D2
name: adjust_tables_with_flag_fallbacks
description: Applies fixed-point adjustments to parallel table entries walking backwards, with fallback factors when a flag test fails. It returns once all entries are processed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2906
name: adjust_tables_resume_at_entry
description: Resumes the backwards adjustment of parallel table entries, applying fixed-point steps to three tables and a flag-selected scale to the output table. It returns when the index reaches the start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:295C
name: adjust_tables_with_class_scaling
description: Applies fixed-point scaling to parallel table entries as the walk moves backwards, choosing each factor from the flag bits of the entry. It returns at the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:296A
name: adjust_tables_by_flag_steps
description: Walks entries backwards and adjusts parallel tables with fixed-point steps chosen by flag bits, using a fallback factor at the end of a block. It returns at the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2970
name: adjust_tables_with_fixed_factor
description: Applies a fixed-point factor to a table entry, then continues walking entries backwards with flag-selected adjustments until the start of the table. It returns once the walk completes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:298E
name: adjust_tables_alternate_factors
description: Alternates between two fixed-point factors while walking table entries backwards, adjusting parallel tables when flag bits match. It returns at the table start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A2
name: decay_run_values_forward
description: Copies table values forward one step at a time, scaling a running value by a table entry each step and subtracting it from the copy. The results are also written to a third table, and the loop ends when its count runs out.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A4
name: decay_run_values_count_zero
description: Repeats the forward copy with running scaling for a counted run, subtracting the scaled value from each copy and mirroring the result into a third table. It returns once the counter reaches the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29D4
name: run_handler_sequence_twelve
description: Calls an unnamed handler routine twelve times in a row, then calls it once more when a status byte is nonzero. It returns after the sequence.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A4A
name: call_three_handlers_in_sequence
description: Calls an unnamed handler routine three times in a row and returns. It holds no data of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A6A
name: interpolate_stride_eight_values
description: Linearly interpolates between two byte endpoints across a number of steps, writing each interpolated value into every eighth byte of a buffer. It returns after the last step is written.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A92
name: walk_byte_records_until_end
description: Walks eight-byte records, skipping entries marked with minus two and calling an unnamed handler for records that are not the first. It returns when a record with the end marker of minus one is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AA4
name: walk_records_with_handler_calls
description: Walks eight-byte records and calls an unnamed handler between records whose marker differs from the previous one. It stops when the marker byte equals minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AB6
name: call_handler_then_walk_records
description: Calls an unnamed handler routine, then walks eight-byte records, skipping those marked minus two and stopping at the end marker of minus one. It calls the handler again between records that differ.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ABA
name: scan_records_until_sentinel
description: Scans eight-byte records for nonzero marker bytes, calling an unnamed handler for records after the first, and returns when the sentinel of minus one is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AD0
name: scan_records_skip_zero_stride
description: Steps through eight-byte records skipping zero marker bytes, calling an unnamed handler between records, and returns when the end marker of minus one is read.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ADC
name: scan_records_with_leading_handler
description: Walks eight-byte records and calls an unnamed handler before each scan, stepping past records whose marker byte is zero. It returns when the end marker of minus one is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AE0
name: write_table_driven_pattern_records
description: Reads a command table and a count table, and for each entry either copies five-value patterns chosen by the command byte or writes counted eight-byte records with added increments. It stops at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B10
name: emit_pattern_records_from_commands
description: Writes eight-byte output records from a command byte stream: plain commands copy a count of records, while flagged commands copy five-value patterns chosen by the command. It returns when the command stream reaches 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B6A
name: emit_command_pattern_records
description: Reads command and count streams, writing five-value patterns chosen by command for flagged commands and counted eight-byte records with additive steps otherwise. It returns when the command stream reaches the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B70
name: emit_command_pattern_records_resume
description: Resumes writing command-driven records, copying five-value patterns for flagged commands and counted records with additive steps for the rest. It returns when the end marker of 255 is read from the command stream.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B82
name: emit_command_pattern_records_split
description: Writes counted records for each command byte, using five-value patterns for the matched command codes and additive steps for paired fields. It returns when the end marker of 255 is read.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B92
name: emit_patterns_for_command_codes
description: Chooses one of several five-value source patterns from the command code and writes it repeatedly for each counted step, then continues the command stream. It returns at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BA2
name: emit_command_pattern_records_tail
description: Writes five-value patterns for command codes at the end of the command stream, then emits counted eight-byte records with additive steps. It returns when the command stream reaches the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BC6
name: update_record_nibbles_from_flags
description: Rewrites the low nibbles of paired record fields with halved, rounded values for flagged commands, and clears the high nibble of the affected fields. It returns at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BF2
name: update_record_nibbles_with_repeat
description: Applies masked nibble updates to paired record fields and repeats earlier records for commands one and two, stopping at the end marker of 255. It writes the carried flag bits back into the record table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C02
name: update_record_nibbles_masked
description: Walks command bytes and record bytes together, copying repeat records forward and rewriting masked low nibbles in paired record fields for flagged commands. It returns when the terminator value of 255 is read.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C32
name: update_record_nibbles_chain
description: Continues the chained record update, copying earlier records for repeat commands and rewriting masked nibbles for others, and sets a carry flag on each processed command. It returns at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2CEC
name: update_record_nibbles_tail
description: Applies the masked nibble updates to the trailing record fields and copies repeat records forward for the remaining commands. It returns when the command stream reaches the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D1C
name: remap_record_bytes_through_table
description: Walks eight-byte records and replaces the first three bytes of each with values from a lookup table, skipping records whose marker is 254. It stops at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D3E
name: lookup_three_bytes_per_record
description: Replaces the first three bytes of each eight-byte record with values taken from a lookup table, moving forward until a marker byte matches the end value. Records with the skip marker are passed over.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D52
name: stub_return_only
description: Returns immediately without touching any data. It is an empty stub, not a real routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D54
name: accumulate_record_sums_into_slot
description: For each eight-byte record, adds up its six leading byte fields until an end marker of 255 is met, then adds the sum shifted right by three into a fixed byte of the record stream.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D70
name: sum_record_fields_into_slot
description: Adds record fields with fixed weights across six-field groups until a stop marker matches, then writes the shifted total into a fixed slot of each record. The walk advances through the record table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D86
name: combine_weighted_record_fields
description: For each record, sums fields with doubled weights, subtracts the first and seventh fields, and combines the result with the slot value scaled by four. The combined value is shifted right by four and stored back in the slot.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DA4
name: combine_weighted_fields_by_stride
description: Accumulates weighted field values in a strided walk over records and stores a shifted combination in each record's slot byte. It repeats until the stop marker is matched.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DCA
name: apply_command_offsets_to_records
description: Walks command and count streams and adds a per-command offset byte to the seventh byte of each counted record, with special offsets for two command codes and a fixed fill for one. It returns at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DEC
name: add_command_offsets_record_seventh
description: Adds command-dependent offsets to the seventh byte of counted records, using a shifted field for one command group and fixed fills for others. It stops when the command stream reaches the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E38
name: add_command_offsets_resume_loop
description: Resumes adding command-dependent offsets to the seventh record byte across counted runs, with a fixed offset for two command codes. It returns when the end marker of 255 is read.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E48
name: add_fixed_offsets_per_run
description: Walks command and count streams, adding a fixed offset to the seventh byte of each record in a counted run. The offset depends on the command group, and the loop stops at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E4C
name: add_fixed_offsets_command_groups
description: Writes fixed offsets to the seventh record byte for counted runs, choosing the offset from the command group and skipping records for fill commands. It returns when the command stream reaches 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E50
name: add_fixed_offsets_until_terminator
description: Adds group-dependent offsets to the seventh byte of counted records until the command stream reaches the terminator value of 255. Some command codes apply a shifted field update instead of a fixed offset.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E54
name: add_fixed_offsets_mixed_groups
description: Writes fixed fill offsets into the seventh byte of counted records, mixing fill runs with counted groups from the command stream. It returns when the command stream reaches the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E68
name: add_offsets_with_shifted_field
description: Adds offsets derived from a shifted field to the seventh record byte in counted runs, and fixed fills for command group codes. It returns at the end marker of 255.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E80
name: average_nibbles_in_sliding_window
description: Slides a window of five bytes across a buffer, summing low nibbles of neighbouring bytes with weights and writing the shifted result into one nibble of a fixed byte. A second pass does the same with high nibbles.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5230
name: setup_task_signals_wait_loop
description: Looks up the current task through an Exec library call and stores it, allocates two signal bits and records their combined mask, then loops calling a handler and waiting for signals. The library calls are the task lookup, signal allocation and wait functions.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:526E
name: drain_message_port_until_empty
description: Takes messages from a message port with the Exec GetMsg call, storing messages that are not of type 2 in the state block, until the port is empty or a stop flag is set. It then clears the busy flags and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52A4
name: clear_busy_status_flags
description: Clears two status bits in the state block and returns. It has no other effect.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52B4
name: initialise_audio_channels_and_dma
description: Fills channel tables and computes a period value from a fixed constant divided by a stored value, calls library routines to set up message and list nodes, and writes the custom chip DMA control register before the sample output loop.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5370
name: copy_thirtythree_byte_blocks
description: Copies blocks of 33 bytes from a source buffer to a destination, advancing both pointers, until the block count is used up. It returns when the copy loop ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:548A
name: mix_sample_stream_channel_records
description: Mixes sample bytes from lookup tables into the output buffer while parsing channel records that set envelope and table pointers. It rewrites the DMA control register when the stream ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5514
name: mix_wave_samples_position_masks
description: Writes combined wave-table samples into the output buffer while stepping sample positions with masks and advancing a block counter. At block end it switches output buffers and returns when the stream is finished.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:558C
name: mix_three_table_samples
description: Sums three lookup-table sample values per step into an output buffer, updating position and envelope counters and rewriting the DMA control register at block boundaries. It returns once the stream of blocks ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5610
name: mix_channel_with_envelope_updates
description: Mixes sample bytes from lookup tables into the output buffer while parsing channel records that set envelope and table pointers and clear parameters when a flag is set. It rewrites the DMA control register on completion.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56AE
name: mix_channel_records_into_buffer
description: Mixes three table samples per step into the output buffer, parsing channel records as they are reached and wrapping the sample position. It returns when the record stream ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56DC
name: mix_block_position_wrap
description: Mixes sample bytes from lookup tables into the output buffer for one block, wrapping the sample position and parsing channel records as they are reached. It rewrites the DMA control register when the stream is finished.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56EA
name: stop_channels_and_reset_dma
description: Calls an unnamed routine once per channel and, when a channel's status bit is set, clears it and writes the DMA control register with the channel-enable mask. It re-enables that mask at the end when the bit remains set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:573E
name: write_dma_enable_flag
description: Writes the custom chip DMA control register with the channel-enable mask when a status flag is set, then returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5758
name: relink_entry_on_value_change
description: When a byte value differs from the stored one, it updates the stored value and moves a list node: it unlinks the first node, relinks it to a list head, decrements a counter, and calls a library routine. It writes a control mask to a hardware register when the counter drops below one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57CA
name: decrement_counter_reset_mask
description: Decrements a counter stored in the state block and writes a control mask to a hardware register when the previous value was below one. It returns after the update.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57DA
name: mark_channel_nodes_start_dma
description: Marks each node of a channel list as pending by calling a library routine for it, then clears a status bit and writes the DMA control register to start playback. If a stop bit was set instead, it sends the closing request and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57F6
name: mark_channel_nodes_from_offset
description: Marks channel list nodes from a computed offset as pending, calling a library routine for each, and then restarts DMA or sends the closing request depending on a status bit. It returns once the list is handled.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5838
name: wait_channels_idle_disable_dma
description: Calls an unnamed routine for each channel until one reports busy, in which case it sets a busy bit and returns. When all channels are idle it writes the DMA control register to disable them.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:587A
name: set_busy_status_bit
description: Sets the busy bit in a state byte and returns. It does nothing else.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:S/Message:0:0000
name: conditionally_call_library_then_handler
description: Calls two unnamed routines, calls a library routine at a negative offset when a condition flag is clear, then calls one more unnamed routine and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:S/Message:0:0034
name: store_library_call_result
description: Calls a library routine through a global base address and stores the returned value in a shared variable.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:endcli:0:0136
name: copy_fifteen_longwords_and_call
description: Copies fifteen 32-bit words from a fixed table into the destination when that pointer is non-null, then calls a routine through a function pointer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:0000
name: start_and_reference_imp_text
description: Program entry point that references the text IMP! and makes one call to an unnamed routine. The decompiler produced no pseudo-code, so this description rests on the listed facts alone.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:001A
name: set_background_colour_then_jump
description: Touches the background colour hardware register, then passes control through a jump-table entry to a fixed address and makes one further unnamed call. The decompiler produced no pseudo-code, so this description rests on the listed facts alone.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:0048
name: decrunch_backwards_bitstream_block
description: Decompresses data in place from the end of a buffer toward the start, reading a bit stream to choose literal and copied runs. It copies a block of pointer words and returns when the write position reaches the buffer start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:009A
name: read_bitstream_length_code
description: Decodes a variable-length code from a backwards bit stream by counting bit groups, producing a small count and a base value for the decompressor. It calls five unnamed routines while the stream is consumed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:00D2
name: decode_backref_copy_loop
description: Decodes length and distance codes from the backwards bit stream, copies a back-reference and then a literal run into the output buffer, and repeats until the buffer start is reached. It returns a success flag at the end.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:00F6
name: stub_single_call_forward
description: A three-instruction routine that makes one call to an unnamed routine. The supplied pseudo-code is a different large routine, so this description rests on the listed facts alone.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:00FC
name: stub_single_call_forward
description: A three-instruction routine that makes one call to an unnamed routine. The supplied pseudo-code does not match these instructions, so this description rests on the listed facts alone.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:0102
name: stub_single_call_forward
description: A three-instruction routine that makes one call to an unnamed routine. The supplied pseudo-code does not match these instructions, so this description rests on the listed facts alone.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:0108
name: relay_through_shared_call_site
description: A seventeen-instruction routine with five callers that makes one call to an unnamed routine. The supplied pseudo-code does not match these instructions, so this description rests on the listed facts alone.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:012C
name: setup_then_call_unnamed_routine
description: A twenty-eight-instruction routine with one caller that makes one call to an unnamed routine. The supplied pseudo-code does not match these instructions, so this description rests on the listed facts alone.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:intro:0:0168
name: setup_and_call_unnamed_routine
description: A seventeen-instruction routine with one caller that makes one call to an unnamed routine. The supplied pseudo-code does not match these instructions, so this description rests on the listed facts alone.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0000
name: create_and_add_translator_library
description: Library code in the translator library: calls the Exec MakeLibrary function to create a library base, then AddLibrary to register it with the system, storing the segment pointer in the new base. It returns zero on failure and a minus-one success code otherwise.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0040
name: increment_counter_clear_status_bit
description: Library handler that increments a 16-bit counter in the library structure and clears one status bit in a flag byte. It returns nothing.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0056
name: decrement_counter_and_notify
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in the library structure and, when it reaches zero with a status bit set, calls an unnamed routine and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0070
name: unlink_node_or_flag_pending
description: If a counter is zero, unlinks a node from a list and calls a library routine with a stored value. Otherwise it sets a pending status bit and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:008A
name: unlink_node_and_call_library
description: Unlinks a node from a doubly linked list, then calls a library routine at a fixed offset with a stored value and returns that value. It is library code in the translator library.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0134
name: parse_text_fields_into_buffer
description: Library code that fills a 26-byte buffer with spaces, then scans an input string for space-separated fields until a hash terminator, calling unnamed routines to read each field. It returns the final scan status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:01A4
name: return_low_word_register
description: Returns the low 16 bits of a data register as its result. The fact list reports one unnamed call, but the listing shows only the return.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:01A8
name: clear_flag_return_word
description: Calls an unnamed routine, clears a flag byte addressed from an address register, and returns a 16-bit value from a data register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:01CA
name: scan_text_fields_space_delimiters
description: Scans text fields separated by spaces, calling unnamed routines for each field, and stops at a hash terminator. It returns the scan status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:01E6
name: scan_text_fields_until_hash
description: Continues scanning space-delimited text fields until a hash terminator, clears the end byte and returns the scan status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0202
name: scan_escape_sequences_in_text
description: Scans text one character at a time, stopping at a backslash or a backquote, and calls unnamed routines to handle the escape. It returns when the text ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0226
name: scan_text_for_escape_markers
description: Scans text for backslash and backquote markers, calling unnamed routines to handle each marker and continuing until the text ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:023A
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only a return appears in the listing, although the facts report sixteen instructions, so this is a stub or bad instruction data. It has no effect when called.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0266
name: copy_bracketed_text_span
description: Skips characters until an opening bracket, then copies the following characters into a buffer up to the closing bracket and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0292
name: scan_backward_for_flagged_characters
description: Walks a buffer backwards one character at a time and stops on characters whose lookup flag is set. It returns when the start of the buffer is passed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:02B0
name: stub_return_only
description: Returns immediately with no effect. The listing contains only the return.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:02B6
name: scan_counted_text_chunks
description: Repeatedly calls unnamed routines to handle text chunks, counting down a length and returning when the count goes negative or a status flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:02C4
name: read_token_until_equals
description: Reads characters from a text buffer until an equals sign, classifying each one with a lookup table flag, and returns when the terminator is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:02EA
name: scan_text_chunks_forward
description: Scans text chunks forward through a buffer, calling unnamed routines for each chunk and returning when a status flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:02F8
name: measure_text_run_to_marker
description: Scans forward for a backslash or a backquote and returns the length of the text run up to that marker, packed into a register pair.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0314
name: terminate_text_at_flagged_char
description: Walks backwards through a text buffer until a character with a lookup flag is found, then writes a zero terminator at that position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:032C
name: copy_text_run_flag_update
description: Copies a counted run of bytes into a destination buffer, sets a status flag, and checks the next byte for a backquote marker before finishing.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:035E
name: terminate_text_before_flagged_char
description: Walks backwards through a text buffer until a character with a lookup flag is found, then writes a zero terminator after the preceding text and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0398
name: dispatch_by_marker_character
description: Searches a twelve-character marker table for the current byte and calls the handler at the matching position of a jump table, then returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:03BE
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only a return appears in the listing, although four instructions are reported. It is called by fourteen routines and has no effect.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:03C6
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only a return appears in the listing, although six instructions are reported, so this is a stub or bad instruction data. It has no effect.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:03D4
name: relay_single_unnamed_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:03DC
name: call_routine_while_flag_set
description: Calls an unnamed routine once, then keeps calling it while a status bit in a register is set, and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:03F2
name: relay_unnamed_call_on_handler
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns. It is a handler stub in the translator library.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0400
name: check_status_char_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then when a status bit is set calls another and compares the returned character with I and E before returning.
